description: This file defines an interface ILocalStore within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace, establishing a contract for local storage operations such as opening a store, creating tables, inserting entries, setting limits, and retrieving or removing entries.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface for managing local storage tables, entries, and limits.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the local store with the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries within a range in a table.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Fetches a list of entries from a table starting at a specific position.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries within a specified range from a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a single entry to a specified table.
